final: WITH ratios AS (SELECT p.SEX, 1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID), groups AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM groups), kept AS (SELECT g.avg_ratio FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f WHERE g.avg_ratio > f.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(k.avg_ratio - f.value) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(k.avg_ratio - s.value) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE k.avg_ratio > s.value
